== Checklist and release dates ==
The [{{fullurl:Theed Palace|oldid=352916}} checked set checklist] shows 129 playable printings and 131 playable faces because the two Objectives each have two faces. The 131 physical items in the product include two rules and checklist cards.

Decipher’s [https://web.archive.org/web/20030403064537id_/http://www2.decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/reflections3/r3cardlist.pdf Reflections III collector’s list] attributes six October 2001 foils to Theed Palace. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20011212170750id_/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/expansions/theedpalace/index.html December product page] separately describes the two Episode I tournament foils as previously available through tournament play. The 12 December 2001 date is for the nonfoil Theed Palace retail expansion.
